target_preservation: No root definition, prior target file, source function, package pin or historical receipt may be edited.

targets.statement: For a finite set S of complex nodes excluding r and conjugate r, Im r != 0, construct a polynomial P with P(r)=i, P(conjugate r)=-i, P(w)=0 for w in S, and P(conjugate z)=conjugate(P(z)). S need not be conjugation-closed.
The two selected squared values with arbitrary positive weights m1,m2 contribute -(m1+m2). No equality of multiplicities or fourfold orbit weights is assumed.
G_L(z)=P(z)*exp(-L*((z-Re r)^2+(Im r)^2)); norm squared is |P(z)|^2 exp(-2 L D(z)), D=(Re z-Re r)^2+(Im r)^2-(Im z)^2. G_L agrees with P at r and conjugate r.
For |Im z|<=1/2 and |Re z-Re r|>=1, D>=3/4 and |G_(n+1)(z)|^2 <= exp(-3n/2)*|G_1(z)|^2 for all natural n. P and finite S are fixed before n.
If b is summable and ||f_i||<=q*b_i, prove f summable and ||sum f_i||<=q*sum b_i. From any mass>0 and finite C obtain n with exp(-3n/2)*C<mass, not by an unproved terminating search.

Use pinned ZetaZeros compact-finiteness and existing zero-strip theorem to form a finite source window 0<=Re s<=1, t-1<=Im s<=t+1. Its frequency image, after removing r and conjugate r, is an admissible S covering every non-target actual zero with |Im s-t|<=1.
For a!=0 and mass>0, scale=mass/(16*a^4)>0 and scale*witnessTrace 2 a t=-mass, linking the negative pair margin to the existing finite-residual quartic consumer.

open_source_obligations: Native replay of candidates and selected complete dependency closure.
Actual analytic zero multiplicity positivity and indexing.
Weighted Gaussian moment summability for actual zeta zeros.
Admissibility and exact Weil/arithmetic source identity for the constructed tests.
Source nonnegativity without assuming RH or equivalent positivity.
negative_controls: Target/conjugate in S must be rejected.
Im r=0 is outside pair normalizer domain, not omitted from RH.
Repeated interpolation factors do not imply analytic zero multiplicity.
Squared moduli must not replace signed squares.
Strip and far-window hypotheses cannot be dropped.
A shrinking Gaussian alone need not suppress nearby off-line zeros.
Finite support success cannot establish an infinite summability theorem.
C depends on the fixed P and source zero, not on the Gaussian index.
No zero set is numerically fabricated as actual zeta zeros.
